target: 100% completion of the original Nintendo DS release, including Classic, Rebirth, all ending flags, clear-data rewards, Master of Knifing, and local wireless modes, spoiler-free

areas.name: DS Route and Campaign Modes
areas.location_cue: The DS title menu, both screens, and the opening playable rooms.
areas.note: Configure the only complete platform route before creating clear data.

levels.1: This version depends on two-screen input.
levels.2: Run the original Nintendo DS game with touch and microphone input available.
levels.3: Use DS hardware or a tested emulator, verify both screens render without cropping, map the touch panel accurately, test microphone input, and keep a clean save before beginning either ruleset.

levels.1: Precise short strokes matter in the added challenges.
levels.2: Test taps, straight drags, and diagonal drags on the lower screen.
levels.3: Calibrate the stylus before the first campaign. Confirm a tap lands under the cursor, each cardinal drag reads cleanly, and rapid taps do not become swipes; emulator mouse scaling must remain one-to-one.

levels.1: Several Rebirth interactions listen for breath.
levels.2: Confirm the DS microphone responds before starting Rebirth mode.
levels.3: Open the hardware or emulator microphone test, sustain a moderate breath, and confirm the input meter moves. Avoid always-on noise injection because it can trigger a puzzle or defensive response at the wrong moment.

items.label: Clear Classic with the Eight-Slot Character

levels.1: The room layout is familiar, but one inventory route is more forgiving.
levels.2: Finish Classic mode once with the eight-slot character and save the clear data.
levels.3: Choose Classic at the title screen, select the character with eight inventory spaces and lock-picking access, finish the route, and save the completion record. Keep this clear slot separate from Rebirth progress.

items.label: Clear Classic with the Six-Slot Character

levels.1: The smaller inventory creates a distinct route.
levels.2: Finish Classic mode once with the six-slot character and save the clear data.
levels.3: Start a separate Classic file with six inventory spaces, collect the small keys needed for simple locks, finish the route, and retain its clear record. Do not overwrite the other character's completion.

items.label: Clear Rebirth with the Eight-Slot Character

levels.1: The DS-specific ruleset changes puzzles and encounters.
levels.2: Finish Rebirth mode once with the eight-slot character.
levels.3: Select Rebirth, use the eight-slot route, solve every mandatory touch or microphone interaction, finish the campaign, and save the result so its character unlock can be verified in wireless play.

items.label: Clear Rebirth with the Six-Slot Character

levels.1: The alternate inventory route also has unique DS rewards.
levels.2: Finish Rebirth mode once with the six-slot character.
levels.3: Create another Rebirth file with six spaces, account for its different coloured-node chest solutions, complete all mandatory DS interactions, and retain the clear data for the corresponding wireless unlock.

levels.1: A title-screen input exposes a gentler ruleset.
levels.2: Highlight Classic or Rebirth and hold Right until the difficulty label changes colour.
levels.3: At mode selection, rest on Classic or Rebirth without confirming and hold Right long enough for the label to turn green. Start the run and verify the increased ammunition and reduced enemy durability; this setting does not grant completion rewards.

save_backup.title: Keep separate clear slots
save_backup.why: Classic, Rebirth, ending flags, and timed unlock checks should not overwrite one another.

point_of_no_return.title: The central elevator starts the final sequence
point_of_no_return.why: Finish files, terminals, cell work, and the intended save branch before entering.

areas.name: Rebirth Touch and Microphone Checklist
areas.location_cue: Optional blue containers and altered mechanisms across the mansion, guardhouse, tunnels, and laboratory.
areas.note: Complete each DS-only interaction on a backed-up Rebirth route.

levels.1: An optional blue container rewards a clean node sequence.
levels.2: Open the Rebirth container in the western first-floor save room; its sequence depends on the selected inventory route.
levels.3: Save before touching the panel. Enter eight-slot: E-D, B-D, D-C, E-A; six-slot: B-D, D-A, E-C. Do not improvise after a wrong link: cancel or reload, repeat the sequence from the beginning, and confirm the container yields Red Herb / Shotgun Shells.

levels.3: Save before touching the panel. Enter eight-slot: A-C, E-C, B-D, D-F; six-slot: E-C, B-D, A-D, E-B. Do not improvise after a wrong link: cancel or reload, repeat the sequence from the beginning, and confirm the container yields Shotgun Shells.

levels.2: Open the Rebirth container in the eastern lower-laboratory save room; its sequence depends on the selected inventory route.

levels.1: The familiar clock now expects direct manipulation.
levels.2: Rotate the dining-room clock to 3:00 in Rebirth mode.
levels.3: After returning the gold emblem, drag the clock hands until the hour hand points to 3 and the minute hand to 12. Confirm before leaving and collect the Shield Key from the opened compartment.

levels.1: The vent puzzle is replaced by coloured weights.
levels.2: Balance the touch-screen scale in the upper green-door room.
levels.3: For the six-slot route, place two red jewels plus green, blue, and yellow. For the eight-slot route, use blue, red, two green, and yellow. Confirm both pans settle level, then take the Sun Crest.

levels.1: A timed aid sequence uses steady breath.
levels.2: During the eight-slot Rebirth route, breathe into the microphone at the injured-officer interaction.
levels.3: Begin only after the prompt appears, then give several even breaths rather than one sharp blast. Watch the response meter and pause between breaths. Successful aid provides the 8:12 clock cue and Shotgun Shells; reload if the sequence fails.

levels.1: The flooded control room adds a manual valve.
levels.2: Turn the guardhouse control-room valve counter-clockwise until four red indicators illuminate.
levels.3: Reach the drain controls, pull the main lever, then immediately drag around the valve in repeated counter-clockwise circles. Keep the motion inside the ring until all four lamps are red and the water has fully lowered.

levels.1: The adjacent door uses a number-grid check.
levels.2: Set the guardhouse electro-lock to the 3×3 grid 843 / 591 / 267.
levels.3: After draining the water, open the wall panel and arrange the rows as 8-4-3, 5-9-1, and 2-6-7. Confirm the totals display 15, 8, and 3, unlock the supply room, and take the 003 Dormitory Key.

levels.1: A dark display needs the room's air disturbed.
levels.2: Blow out the candle in the western upper display room.
levels.3: Stand beside the lit candle and give one controlled breath into the microphone. Once darkness exposes the glint, move the step ladder beneath it, climb, and take the Red Jewel from the mounted display.

levels.1: An upstairs music device must hold a steady speed.
levels.2: Spin the record clockwise and keep its meter in the green zone.
levels.3: Place the stylus near the record edge and trace smooth clockwise circles. Adjust speed gradually so the gauge stays green through the final segment; lifting early resets progress. Complete it before approaching the room's next encounter.

levels.1: The drop route contains a brief precision test.
levels.2: Tap each blue point between the fingers after entering the second-rope opening.
levels.3: When the lower screen shows the hand, tap only the currently blue gap. The sequence accelerates and eventually uses all six positions; keep the stylus close, avoid the fingers, and finish before descending the exposed ladder.

levels.1: One tunnel door needs a carried weapon as a tool.
levels.2: Use the Flamethrower on the western underground door panel.
levels.3: Take the Flamethrower from the wall after dropping underground, carry it through the west passage, and fire at the marked panel until it releases the door. Preserve enough fuel and remember that a wall holder may still be needed to reopen the return path.

levels.1: Rebirth adds one document behind movable shelving.
levels.2: Read Eric's Letter behind the bookcase in the western upper mansion rooms.
levels.3: During the mansion return, enter the upstairs library section, operate the light-and-statue arrangement that shifts the bookcase, and inspect the revealed document before leaving for the courtyard. Open it once in the file menu to register it.

save_backup.title: Save before each DS panel
save_backup.why: Failed timed inputs can consume health, close a reward attempt, or force a room reset.

areas.name: Ending Flag Matrix
areas.location_cue: The route-support choices, three MO Disk readers, optional cell, and final elevator.
areas.note: The labels expose only mechanical flag combinations.

levels.1: Two route flags determine this final variation.
levels.2: Finish the eight-slot route with support inactive and the optional cell closed.
levels.3: Do not wait for the second rope; then leave the optional laboratory cell closed. Keep a save before the central elevator, complete the final route, and record the result without overwriting the shared branch backup.

save_backup.why: Both ending flags must already match the intended variation.

point_of_no_return.why: Restore the pre-elevator save to test the paired cell or support state.

areas.name: Clear-Data Unlocks
areas.location_cue: The results screen, first item box, and first-floor dressing room.
areas.note: Verify each reward on loaded clear data rather than assuming the result saved.

levels.1: The strongest route result opens a wardrobe on a later cycle.
levels.2: Complete the eight-slot best-result ending and save clear data.
levels.3: Keep both route flags active: wait for the returning rope and open the optional cell with three MO Disks. Finish the run, save clear data, load it, and confirm the Special Key appears for the new cycle.

levels.1: The other character has an equivalent wardrobe key.
levels.2: Complete the six-slot best-result ending and save clear data.
levels.3: Preserve the support route, open the optional cell with all three MO Disks, finish the run, and save the result. Begin from that clear data and verify the Special Key is available.

levels.1: One wardrobe contains two choices.
levels.2: Use the eight-slot Special Key in the first-floor dressing room and select the first outfit.
levels.3: Load the correct clear data, carry the Special Key to the northeastern first-floor wardrobe beyond the Armor Key door, unlock it, choose the first alternate outfit, and pass through a corridor to confirm it remains equipped.

levels.1: Return to the same unlocked wardrobe.
levels.2: Select the second eight-slot outfit from the first-floor dressing room.
levels.3: On the same clear-data cycle, revisit the unlocked wardrobe, interact again until the other alternate costume is worn, leave the room, and inspect the inventory model. Keep both outfit checks in the completion ledger.

levels.1: The six-slot route also has two wardrobe changes.
levels.2: Use the six-slot Special Key and select the first outfit.
levels.3: Start from the six-slot best-result clear, unlock the first-floor dressing room's inner wardrobe, equip its first alternate costume, and move into the hall to verify the model persists.

levels.1: A second change completes that wardrobe.
levels.2: Return with the six-slot clear data and select the other outfit.
levels.3: Re-enter the already unlocked dressing room, cycle to the remaining six-slot costume, confirm the change, and leave through a door. Record it separately from the first wardrobe choice.

levels.1: A fast best-result clear awards the strongest replay weapon.
levels.2: Finish a campaign below 3:00:00 with both route flags active.
levels.3: Use either character and either ruleset, retain the support flag, open the optional cell, skip nonessential pickups and door animations, and finish before the timer reaches three hours. Save the clear record, load it, and verify the unlimited launcher in the first item box.

areas.name: Master of Knifing
areas.location_cue: Five first-person touch challenges selected from the main menu.
areas.note: Complete and rank both character routes; visible labels withhold enemy identities.

levels.1: Any completed campaign opens a touch-only challenge.
levels.2: Clear one campaign and return to the title menu.
levels.3: Save the campaign completion when prompted, return to the main menu without deleting that record, and confirm Master of Knifing is selectable. A clear in Classic or Rebirth is sufficient.

levels.1: Accuracy, combos, time, and damage shape the result.
levels.2: Clear Master of Knifing stage 1 with the eight-slot character and earn S rank.
levels.3: Use taps for forward stabs and drags for slashes, counter immediately before an incoming hit for critical damage, and blow back projectile attacks when prompted. Maintain a combo, minimize damage, finish quickly, and verify S on the stage-1 results.

levels.1: A solid knife-mode result opens a wireless roster slot.
levels.2: Finish every Master of Knifing stage at B rank or better.
levels.3: Use one character for a complete five-stage run, secure at least B on each result through clean critical counters and low damage, return to the wireless character screen, and confirm the seventh slot is selectable.

areas.name: Local Wireless Completion
areas.location_cue: Three compact maps entered through two-to-four-player local wireless.
areas.note: No online matchmaking exists; retain the host save that receives the roster unlocks.

levels.1: This mode cannot be completed alone on one system.
levels.2: Prepare two to four DS systems and matching game cards within local-wireless range.
levels.3: Use at least two physical systems or a tested emulator setup that genuinely supports DS local multiplayer. Give every participant a separate save, connect through the game's wireless lobby, and confirm movement synchronizes before attempting completion clears.

levels.1: This roster choice is initially available.
levels.2: Make wireless slot 1 selectable; condition: available from the start.
levels.3: On the save that will host multiplayer, available from the start. Return to the local-wireless character screen, move the cursor onto slot 1, begin a stage with it, and retain that save so the unlock is not lost.

levels.3: Coordinate room changes because the team shares health; each player must collect required quest items, while only one player may claim a blue box. Keep every participant connected through the Mansion exit, remain until results appear, and verify the host save records the Co-op clear.
